title: Suzanne RP NDE 4365
content: I was in 11th grade and attended the local high school. I had an after school part time job at a doctor's office as a clerk. On this particular day, I had a dental appointment. I went to work for an hour or two and then went upstairs in the same medical building to the dentist. I had a cavity filled and was given Novocain for pain, so one side of my jaw was numb. After the dentist, I worked for another hour or so and then I left to go meet a friend. We had decided to meet at about 5:30 pm at top of Sav-On which was rooftop parking. Sav-on had an interior stairwell although inside had full-length windows facing the street. I parked on the top lot and my friend who was always late didn't disappoint, so I went inside Sav-on to get this particular flavor of yogurt that I hadn't had anywhere else - Apple Pie a La Mode. Sav-on was sold out of it. So, I went back to my car and on the way up the stairwell a man was coming down and we nodded to each other. Evidently, this same man followed me up the stairs and to my car. I did not realize this until I was seated in the car with my keys in my lap and I pushed the car door open and out in order to slam it shut and that is when the assailant was shockingly there. He got in between the car and the door, thus blocking my ability to close the car door. He knelt down and put one hand on my mouth and the other hand into a fist punching me on the numb side, so I couldn't feel anything. He told me to shut up and give him the keys. I never looked directly at him even though he was inches from me, then he strangled me. The last thing I remember was the graffiti on the wall in front and trying to peel his hands off and then I passed out. It was still daylight out and I don't remember doing this, but I did get up from the parking lot and then fell down on my elbow. Somehow, I felt my way down the stairs. There was a person on the public phone and they helped me to the bathroom. They asked me who did this etc. They asked me where I had come from and I replied the dentist. They asked for my home phone number and I gave my work number. The secretary came over and took me to the office and the doctor, my boss, stitched the back of my head and had the various specialists in the building check my eyes and teeth. My parents were called and they took me to the hospital where I had CT Scans and in between I was questioned by the police. I believe the tunnel of light occurred when I was removed from the car and dropped on the pavement hitting the back of my head.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes Criminal attack Other 'This may be considered 'Life threatening event, but not clinical death.' I was followed to my car and upon sitting I was assaulted with punches to the face and head and then I was strangled by the assailant's bare hands to the point of losing consciousn The pre-dream no, but at the time I saw the light with my grandmother at the other end, yes, I was being or was already assaulted and strangled and thrown out of a car onto the pavement. Incidentally, I don't think the car was moving at the time. I had blood coming from my mouth, nose, both ears, eyes, and the back of my head.
elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: Uncertain I lost awareness of my body
elements.How did your highest level of consciousn: More consciousness and alertness than normal I don't understand the question.
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning Don't understand.
elements.Please compare your hearing during the e: I don't recall. I vaguely remember that I may have begun to mix senses for example I could hear colors and smells - like her perfume.
elements.Did you seem to be aware of things going: Yes, and the facts have been checked out
elements.Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a br: A light clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin
elements.Did you see an unearthly light?: Yes A tunnel of light, but not blinding light. It was not a spot light, but I was in it and it directed my vision upward directly to the other end of the tunnel and it was my grandmother's head.
elements.Did you seem to enter some other, uneart: No On a different dream a different day.
elements.What emotions did you feel during the ex: Frustrated that when I was reaching up to her my grandmother was not responding in a way that I expected. She was not grabbing my hand.
elements.Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity: I felt united or one with the world
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control
elements.Did scenes from the future come to you?: Scenes from the world's future But at a later date I dreamt about the death of my dad a year before it happened.
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will
elements.God, Spiritual and Religion: point of no return? I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will God, Spiritual and Religion
elements.What was your religion prior to your exp: Liberal Baptized Presbyterian... went to Sunday school as a child and Bible Schools at various denominations.
elements.Have your religious practices changed si: Uncertain I am aware of being a good person.
elements.What is your religion now?: Conservative/fundamentalist 'I still don't attend church, but I do believe strongly in the 10 Commandments, Karma, and 'doing the right thing' even if it is not the popular thing...'
elements.Did you have a change in your values and: Uncertain I am aware of being a good person.
elements.Did you seem to encounter a mystical bei: I encountered a definite being, or a voice clearly of mystical or unearthly origin
elements.Concerning our Earthly lives other than: ally saw them Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion
elements.Have your relationships changed specific: Yes At the time yes, I blamed by friend for being late and quit being friends with her.
elements.After the NDE: tionships changed specifically because of your experience? Yes At the time yes, I blamed by friend for being late and quit being friends with her. After the NDE
elements.Was the experience difficult to express: Uncertain Do you mean to relay the experience to someone else or the actual experience itself as it was happening? There was a light tunnel of light and I was in the light. I did not have to go to the light. I didn't hear anything around me. My maternal grandmother was waiting at the end of the tunnel of light She had passed away in 1976. I was in my mind reaching up to her to pull me up and she just shook her head. She didn't say anything. Then, the tunnel at her end closed and was black.
elements.Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or: Yes The account of a friend of a friend breaking his legs. I also dreamt of my dad dying a year before he did. Another dream was that my friend was moving even though I had no contact with her for five to ten years. I tracked her down and it was her last night she was packing (she was the friend that was late the day I was assaulted).
elements.Have you ever shared this experience wit: Yes I had the dream prior to the event and so my family brought the topic up. I had had a concussion and was not all there for some time after the event.
elements.Did you have any knowledge of near death: Uncertain I kept having dreams of being in a white room with giants and giant needles.
elements.What did you believe about the reality o: Experience was definitely real I was strangled and heading up to 'heaven' and my grandmother stopped it and sent me back by closing her end of the tunnel.
elements.What do you believe about the reality of: Experience was definitely real I survived what was meant to be a deadly assault.
